description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the OAuthClientDao within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations related to OAuth client data, such as saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting OAuth clients, as well as setup procedures to populate test data.

classes.name: OAuthClientDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the OAuthClientDao responsible for OAuth client management within the OAuth module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating the OAuthClientDao and populating the database with fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveOAuthClient
methods.description: Tests saving a new OAuthClient object and verifies that its properties are correctly stored and retrieved.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of OAuth clients and asserts expected data for specific entries.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of OAuth clients matching certain search filters.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an OAuth client by ID, verifying expected data or null if not found.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Tests retrieving an OAuth client by its client ID, verifying expected data or null if invalid.

methods.name: testDeleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Tests deleting OAuth clients by ID and verifies the remaining entities in the database.
